answer: Each identity functions as a glacier-stable vertex that must emit a continuous pulse signal of unique proof-of-key ownership. The pulse is a short refreshed zero-knowledge attestation of a burned registration secret. Honest agents pay fixed small compute. An attacker sharing one secret across many identities sees matching pulses collapse to one seat%3B forging distinct secrets costs linear burns plus ongoing pulses scaling with headcount%2C while only unique live signals earn credit%2C making mass sybils unprofitable.
